\section{Model}
The dot couples to a lead with the energy-dependent tunnelling rate $\Gamma(\epsilon)$. Near the band
edge the rate grows linearly with the energy $\epsilon$ measured from the edge, so doubling the energy
doubles the rate:
\begin{equation}
\Gamma(2\epsilon) = 2\,\Gamma(\epsilon) .
\label{eq:rate}
\end{equation}
\appendix
\section{Normalisation}
The normalisation of the band-edge density of states uses the gamma function $\Gamma(\tfrac12)=\sqrt{\pi}$.
